children.text: The paper has the expected sections
children.criterion: 1 only when introduction, method, experiments, results, limitations, and conclusion are present and ordered.

children.text: A reproducibility section names how to rebuild every number
children.criterion: 1 only when the paper names the exact commands and artifact layout for reproduction.

children.text: Every number has a claims entry and artifact
children.criterion: 1 only when each number in paper/** maps to CLAIMS.json with a manifest SHA ancestor of the audited tag.

children.text: Every baseline is the package it says it is
children.criterion: 1 only when a baseline labelled with a package name actually imports and runs that package.

children.text: Tuning effort is comparable and disclosed
children.criterion: 1 only when the baseline and Vangja search budgets are comparable or the asymmetry is disclosed.

children.text: Limitations cover the method's real failure modes
children.criterion: 1 only when negative transfer, MAP uncertainty, and selection effects are named where they apply.

children.text: UQ is calibrated or its lack is disclosed
children.criterion: 1 only when coverage/sharpness/CRPS is reported or the absence is explicitly stated.

children.text: Point-estimate headlines are labelled as such
children.criterion: 1 only when results labelled Bayesian name their estimator (MAP/MCMC/ADVI) and its limits.
1 only when every artefact the statement claims is reachable at the audited tag.

children.text: AI assistance is disclosed per venue policy
children.criterion: 1 only when the AI-use statement names the tools, the tasks, and human verification.

children.text: The contribution matches the venue's scope
children.criterion: 1 only when the claimed contribution is within the target venue's scope and article type.

children.text: Length, structure, and references fit the venue
children.criterion: 1 only when the manuscript meets the venue's formal constraints (length, template, reference style).
